reviews.findings: Research assistant assembled and cross-checked opened sources. This record is not a human approval.
open_questions: Human domain review of publishable wording.

reviews.findings: POWO accepts Monstera deliciosa Liebm.; IPNI confirms authorship/publication. POWO places M. borsigiana and Philodendron pertusum in synonymy.
required_changes: Remove any future presentation of borsigiana as a separate accepted species.
open_questions: Should all POWO synonyms be exposed publicly or only editorially relevant names?

reviews.findings: Species-specific institutional evidence supports insoluble calcium oxalates, human oral/contact irritation, and toxicity to dogs/cats. Severity wording must stay measured.
required_changes: Human approval of French safety wording before publication.
Retain poison-control/veterinary referral for concerning exposure.
required_qualifiers: Irritant/toxic on chewing or ingestion; do not imply airborne toxicity.
Do not equate common oral irritation with inevitable severe poisoning.
open_questions: Select French public-facing poison-control contact policy at Content Master stage.

reviews.findings: POWO is narrower than RHS/NC State/UF horticultural profiles. Likely mixing native, regional and cultivated/introduced concepts.
required_changes: Keep native range and introduced/cultivated distribution separate.

reviews.findings: Muir presents a model-based hypothesis and rejects/qualifies older conjectures; consumer horticultural copy overstates one function.
required_changes: Never state a single proven adaptive function.
open_questions: Whether to include this scientific nuance in the future public page.

reviews.findings: No opened authoritative source supplies the historical 50–75% range. Qualitative preference is supportable.
required_changes: Withhold the exact range from future Content Master unless new direct evidence is found.

reviews.findings: 18–25°C (RHS) and 60–85°F/15.6–29.4°C (NC State) are preferred ranges; outdoor handling and freeze-damage values are different claim types.
required_changes: Do not publish 15°C as a universal minimum.
open_questions: Owner decision: publish RHS 18–25°C with explicit indoor/RHS context or remain qualitative?

reviews.findings: RHS, NC State and UConn converge on checking upper substrate but use different thresholds.
required_changes: Avoid fixed days and false precision.

reviews.findings: RHS offers broad time tendencies; UConn provides observable root/container criteria.
required_changes: Prefer rootball/stability signs over a fixed frequency.

reviews.findings: Sources converge on balanced fertiliser in active growth but differ in frequency and local calendar; UConn flags salt sensitivity.
open_questions: Whether a product-specific Tibaldo recipe will be documented separately.

reviews.findings: Values differ materially because they describe vine length outdoors, horticultural potential and typical home height.
Scores are UI/editorial outputs, not evidence-backed botanical values.
required_changes: Define a documented rubric before reuse.

reviews.findings: Evidence Pack is not a Content Master and cannot self-approve readiness.
required_changes: Resolve or accept listed Owner decisions.
Complete human Taxonomy, Safety and Editorial reviews.
open_questions: Authorize a later Content Master mission only after review.
